title: Effects of high-rate wastewater spray disposal on the water-table aquifer, Hilton Head Island, South Carolina
citation: Speiran, G.K., 1985, Effects of high-rate wastewater spray disposal on the water-table aquifer, Hilton Head Island, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 84-4291, map scale 1:15,400.
notes: Hydrologic report on a wastewater spray site; no named stratigraphic units, so the informal lithologic units of the Hydrology and Soils sections are recorded under the source's own descriptive names. Table 1 drillers' logs (BFT-319, BFT-313) recorded in full; total depths are taken from the deepest log interval and flagged inferred. Water-quality data, the wastewater application table (table 2) and the graphs/maps (figs. 4-17; hydrographs on p. 25 are garbled) were not recorded. The text disagrees on the water table at nest B during the August 1983 application: p. 27 says 3-1/2 ft below land surface, the summary on p. 36 says more than 2-1/2 ft (for August and December); both are recorded. Reference list OCR uses '/' for commas; citations are given with commas. No pages were image-only.
